questions.question: What is the term used to refer to the process of conversion of water vapour back to water?

• **The process of conversion of water vapour back to water is called Condensation**. 
 
• Condensation takes place__:
 __
 
• when the temperature of the air is reduced to dew point with its volume remaining constant.
 
• when both the volume and the temperature are reduced.
 
• when moisture is added to the air through evaporation.
 
 
 
• After condensation the water vapour becomes — **dew, frost, fog and clouds**.

• __**Factors Affecting Rate of Evaporation:**__
 
 
• Amount of water available.
 
• Temperature.
 
• Wind Speed.
 
• Air pressure.
 
• Composition of water.

questions.question: Which of the following glands secrets the hormone called melatonin?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pineal gland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Melatonin**, also known as **hormone of darkness** is a hormone secreted by the **pineal gland** in response to darkness.
 
• The hormone is involved in **sleep regulation**, as well as in a number of other cyclical bodily activities and circadian rhythm in humans.
 
• Melatonin is exclusively involved in **signaling the 'time of day' and 'time of year' **to all tissues and is thus considered as the body's chronological pacemaker or 'Zeitgeber'.
 
• **Pharmacology of Melatonin**-
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdbef39b3fd8dfd78e6e08efbc47062f5365eda8b9803b003006df7dfbbff181.png] 
 
• Light has two effects on melatonin: day-night light cycles modify the rhythm of its secretion, and brief pulses of light of sufficient intensity and duration abruptly suppress its production.
 
• The hormone secretion in humans increases soon after the onset of darkness, peaks within the middle of the night, and gradually falls during the last half of the night.
 
• **Uses**: 
 
 
• **Treatment of sleep problem.**
 
• Act as an** antioxidant** that can significantly affect many health problems.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Food items that contains Melatonin are - **Milk, Fatty fish, Oats, Mushroom, Rice, Bananas**, etc.
 
• Foods to avoid before sleeping are- Chocolate, Tomatoes, Pizza and Citrus fruits.

questions.question: Which of the following acids is responsible for muscle fatigue in humans?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Lactic acid** is a byproduct of anaerobic metabolism, in which the body produces energy without using oxygen.
 
• It forms when the body breaks down carbohydrates to use for energy when oxygen levels are low.
 
• It is responsible for** muscle fatigue** and **tissue damage**.
 
• But lactic acid is an important **fuel source** for muscles during exercise, including those in the heart.
 
• **Effects of Lactic Acids in body: **
 
 
• More than normal lactic acid levels can lead to a condition called **lactic acidosis **which can lead to muscle weakness, rapid breathing, vomiting, sweating, coma.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Molecular formula of Lactic Acid is** CH3CH(OH)COOH**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/19/7_Milchs%C3%A4ure.svg/800px-7_Milchs%C3%A4ure.svg.png] 
 
• Sources- sour milk products such as kumis, laban, yogurt, kefir, and some cottage cheeses.

questions.question: In which year was the first Factory Act passed during colonial rule in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1881**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **committee** appointed in 1875, after inspecting the condition of factories of the passed the first** Factories Act in 1881**.
 
• Following this act, a **Factory Commission** was appointed in 1885.
 
• Then in **1891** another **Factories Act** was adopted.
 
• A **Royal Commission on Labor** was appointed in 1892. 
 
• The main aim of these acts was to **limit the factory working hours**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Factory Act 1891**:

 
 
• Increased the minimum age (**from 7 to 9 years**) & the maximum (**from 12 to 14 years**) for children.
 
• Reduced maximum working hours for children to** 7 hours a day.**

• These are used as fertilizers and it enhances soil quality.

• It develops roots of the plants.
 
• Highly improves the body of the soil.
 
• Vermicomposting increases the fertility and water-resistance properties of the soil.
 
• Helps in the germination, plant growth, and crop yield.
 
• Nourish soil with plant growth hormones like auxins, gibberellic acid, etc.
 
 
 
• **Disadvantages of Vermicomposting:**
 
 
• It is a long and time-consuming process and takes almost six months to convert the organic matter into usable forms.
 
• It releases a very foul odour.
 
• Vermicomposting requires high maintenance. The feed should be added periodically and care should be taken that the worms are not flooded with too much to eat.
 
• The bin should not be too dry or too wet. The moisture levels need to be checked periodically.
 
• They support the expansion of pests and pathogens such as fruit flies, centipede and flies.
